(Nashville, Tennessee) | college = * [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida]] (2020–2024) * [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] (2024–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 37 | draft_team = [[Detroit Pistons]] | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team1 = [[Detroit Pistons]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team2 = →[[Motor City Cruise]] | highlights = * Third-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] – [[National Association of Basketball Coaches|NABC]], [[Sporting News|SN]] ([[2025 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2025]]) * [[Jerry West Award]] (2025) * [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|SEC Newcomer of the Year]] (2025) * First-team [[List of All-SEC men's basketball teams|All-SEC]] (2025) * First-team All-[[ASUN Conference|ASUN]] (2024) }} '''Chaz Harrison Lanier''' (born December 19, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Detroit Pistons]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida Ospreys]] and the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]]. He was selected by the Pistons with the 37th overall pick in the second round of the [[2025 NBA Draft]]. ==High school career== Lanier attended [[The Ensworth School]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]]. As a [[freshman]] in high school, Lanier stood at five feet and six inches; then as a sophomore, he grew to five feet and nine inches. Throughout his [[Junior (education year)|junior]] and [[senior year]], his growth spurt would continue until he was over six feet tall.{{Cite web |title=Chaz Lanier commits to Tennessee Basketball from North Florida |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/tennessee-volunteers/news/chaz-lanier-tennessee-vols-basketball-transfer-portal-north-florida/ |website=[[On3]]|publisher=[[On3]] |date=2024-05-24 |access-date=2025-12-11}} == College career == At the conclusion of his high school career, he committed to the [[University of North Florida]] to play for [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida Ospreys]].{{cite web | last=Kreager | first=Tom | title=Ensworth basketball: Chaz Lanier commits to North Florida | website=The Tennessean | date=2020-03-25 | url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/high-school/2020/03/25/high-school-basketball-recruiting-coronaviirus-chaz-lanier-north-florida/2896464001/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=false&gca-epti=z117455u116955e004200v117455&gca-ft=179&gca-ds=sophi&gnt-djm=1&sltsgmt=0154_E | access-date=2025-08-29}} In his first three seasons, he played primarily in a backup role.{{Cite web |last=Gillaspie |first=Stephen |title=Chaz Lanier: Staying Down For It |url=https://www.noceilingsnba.com/p/chaz-lanier-staying-down-for-it |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=No Cellings |language=en}} As a senior during the 2023–24 season, he averaged 19.7 points per game and was named to the first team All-[[Atlantic Sun Conference|ASUN]].{{Cite web |title=UNF's Chaz Lanier voted first-team All-ASUN, joins teammate Dorian James on all-academic team |url=https://subscribe.jacksonville.com/restricted?return=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jacksonville.com%2Fstory%2Fsports%2Fcollege%2Fbasketball%2F2024%2F03%2F04%2Fchaz-lanier-dorian-james-of-unf-basketball-team-cited-in-asun-awards%2F72828373007%2F&gps-source=CPROADBLOCKDH&itm_source=roadblock&itm_medium=onsite&itm_campaign=premiumroadblock&gca-cat=p&slug=restricted&redirect=true&offer=W-M7&gnt-eid=control |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=Jacksonville}} At the conclusion of the season, Lanier entered the [[NCAA transfer portal|transfer portal]].{{Cite web |date=May 18, 2024 |title=Report: One of the top guards remaining in the portal is visiting BYU |url=https://www.deseret.com/sports/2024/05/17/chaz-lanier-byu-basketball-visit-report-transfer-portal/ |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=Deseret News |language=en}} On May 24, 2024, he transferred to the [[University of Tennessee]] to play for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]].{{Cite web |date=May 24, 2024 |title=Vols land sharpshooting guard Lanier from UNF |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40212293/former-north-florida-guard-chaz-lanier-commits-tennessee |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Mike |title=Chaz Lanier commits to Tennessee basketball over Kentucky after big year at North Florida |url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/05/24/chaz-lanier-tennessee-basketball-transfer-portal-roster-rick-barnes/73267139007/ |website=Knox News}} With Tennessee, he emerged as the team's leading scorer.{{Cite web |last=Sartori |first=John |date=December 24, 2024 |title=One-on-one with Tennessee basketball's Chaz Lanier |url=https://www.wvlt.tv/2024/12/24/one-on-one-with-tennessee-basketballs-chaz-lanier/ |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=WVLT |language=en}} In his first game with Tennessee, Lanier scored a team high 18 points, leading the Volunteers to an 80–64 win over [[Gardner–Webb Runnin' Bulldogs men's basketball|Gardner–Webb]].{{Cite web |last=McGee |first=Trevor |date=November 4, 2024 |title='I never lost confidence': Chaz Lanier leads team in scoring in debut game for Tennessee basketball |url=https://www.utdailybeacon.com/sports/mens_basketball/i-never-lost-confidence-chaz-lanier-leads-team-in-scoring-in-debut-game-for-tennessee/article_58bc8b42-9b27-11ef-a477-33cecf8e21ab.html |access-date=December 26, 2024 |website=The Daily Beacon |language=en}} Against [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] in the [[Jimmy V Classic]], he led the Volunteers in scoring with 22 points, in a 75–62 victory.{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Mike |title=Chaz Lanier is an A-plus for Tennessee basketball. Rick Barnes says there is more to come |url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/12/10/chaz-lanier-tennessee-basketball-miami-rick-barnes/76667989007/ |website=Knox News}}{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Mike |title=Inside Tennessee basketball's win, Chaz Lanier's game vs Miami in Jimmy V Classic |url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/12/10/tennessee-score-miami-basketball-zakai-zeigler/76667992007/ |website=Knox News}} == Professional career == On the second night of the [[2025 NBA draft]], Lanier was selected in the second round with the 37th pick by the [[Detroit Pistons]].{{Cite web |title=Lanier Picked No. 37 in 2025 NBA Draft by Detroit Pistons |url=https://utsports.com/news/2025/6/26/mens-basketball-lanier-picked-no-37-in-2025-nba-draft-by-detroit-pistons |website=UTSports.com |publisher=University of Tennessee Athletics |date=2025-06-26 |access-date=2025-12-09}} He later signed a four-year $8.79 million contract with the team.{{Cite web |title=NBA Insider: Chaz Lanier signs 4-year, $8.79 M deal with Detroit Pistons |url=https://www.si.com/nba/pistons/onsi/news/nba-insider-reveals-key-contract-details-for-detroit-pistons-rookie-01jzm4eqhpr5 |website=[[Sports Illustrated]]|publisher=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=2025-07-09 |access-date=2025-12-09}} On October 24, Lanier made his NBA debut with the team, playing 11 minutes. In those minutes, Lanier grabbed one rebound and scored three points in a 115–111 win against the [[Houston Rockets]].{{Cite web |title=Chaz Lanier makes NBA debut with Detroit Pistons |url=https://volswire.usatoday.com/story/sports/college/volunteers/mens-basketball/2025/10/25/chaz-lanier-makes-nba-debut-with-detroit-pistons/86897641007/ |website=Vols Wire |publisher=USA Today |date=2025-10-25 |access-date=2025-12-09}} On November 18, Lanier scored a career high in points, scoring nine points, and grabbing two rebound in 11 minutes of play in a 120–112 win against the [[Atlanta Hawks]].{{Cite web |title=Detroit Pistons vs Atlanta Hawks 11/18/25|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore/_/gameId/401810106 |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=2025-12-09}} On December 7, Lanier was later [[NBA salary cap|assigned]] to the [[Motor City Cruise]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{Cite web |title=Pistons regret in drafting Chaz Lanier grows as later draft picks break out |url=https://pistonpowered.com/pistons-regret-in-drafting-chaz-lanier-grows-as-later-draft-picks-break-out |website=PistonPowered |publisher=PistonPowered |date=2025-12-08 |access-date=2025-12-09}} On December 10, Lanier scored a career high with the NBA-League team, scoring 40 points in 38 minutes of play.{{Cite web |title=Charge Win in Motor City |url=https://cleveland.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-win-in-motor-city |website=Cleveland G League |publisher=NBA Media Ventures, LLC |access-date=2025-12-09}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player
